source: jnlactive.csv (Elsevier active-journals export, uploaded to posi-data master 2026-08-12; now at source-lists/jnlactive.csv)
bugs_found_and_fixed_before_this_rewrite: naive CSV parsing (line.split(',')) shifted columns for quoted titles containing commas -- caught before original mint, fixed with src/showjcr/csv.mjs's parseCsv()
existingIssns only checked issn_online||issn_print, not both -- verified inert on this dataset (issn_print always null) but fixed for future sources
OpenAlex transient errors could be persisted as fake 404 absences -- verified 0 occurred in practice, fixed for future robustness
mint script re-implemented an ad hoc loop instead of using the tested resolveOrMintIds(), so it never re-verified the CURRENT registry state immediately before minting
the 6 'ambiguous pairs' were reported as unmerged but not actually gated from independent minting -- researched via OpenAlex + Crossref chronology, resolved individually
the 7 old-vs-new supersessions silently orphaned their old posi_id with no record of why -- fixed with the new registry/superseded-ids.csv mechanism
reproducibility: node posi-engine/scripts/ingest-jnlactive-elsevier-2026.mjs --csv jnlactive.csv --benchmark corpus/global-benchmark.json --out <dir>, then scripts/remap-benchmark-identity-2026.mjs, then scripts/mint-elsevier-jnlactive-2026.mjs, then apply the 15 removals in removed-records.csv and the 11 rows in registry/superseded-ids.csv -- see README.md for full detail. (jnlactive.csv moves to source-lists/jnlactive.csv in the follow-up Frontiers-expansion branch.)
